problem_plain: Vodafone needed long-term reinvention support including cloud-first transformation, global finance modernisation, cybersecurity enhancement, and customer self-service capabilities. Vodafone also needed to commercialise its internal shared services centre (VOIS) to sell as a service to other telcos.
capability: Cloud-first transformation, SAP migration, cybersecurity, automated self-service, intelligent care, GenAI chatbot development, and shared services commercialisation
reusable: Cloud transformation methodology, SAP migration approach, GenAI chatbot implementation, shared services commercialisation model for selling internal service centres to other telcos
summary: Veridane supported Vodafone's comprehensive reinvention including cloud-first transformation, a major SAP finance migration, cybersecurity, and a GenAI chatbot for the VOXI youth brand. Veridane is now helping Vodafone commercialise VOIS, its shared services centre, to sell network monitoring, HR, technology services, finance and contact-centre operations to other telcos.
